claims.paraphrase: Page title.
Page purpose line.
Save and Publish sit near the top, or in a fixed bottom bar on a narrow screen.
History, Discard changes, and Delete live in the overflow menu beside them.
Section heading.
Save keeps changes private; other editors can open the saved draft and outsiders need a preview link.
The confirmation note after saving says the site still shows the published version.
Saving protects work and does not publish it.
Section heading.
Publish saves first so the on-screen text goes live without a separate save.
The note after publishing says the live site is rebuilding.
The rebuild usually takes a moment.
Publish stays visible but inactive when nothing is new.
The inactive Publish button explains why on hover or focus.
A page lives at the site address plus its address and other concepts under their own path such as /posts/.
Section heading.
An entry is New, Edited, or Published.
Hidden is a Details checkbox keeping an entry off lists and feeds while reachable by address.
Advice on when to use Hidden.
Section heading.
Entries with a public page carry an Address.
Change URL in Details renames an entry only while it has no unpublished changes.
Section heading.
Discard changes sits in the overflow menu beside Save and Publish.
Discard restores the live version of a published entry and deletes a never-published one.
The dialog states the outcome and discarding cannot be undone.
Section heading.
Delete sits in the overflow menu.
An entry nothing links to gets a plain confirmation that it cannot be undone.
An entry that others link to or include cannot be deleted.
The blocked dialog names what links and links to each entry.
Section heading.
Publish site appears when several entries are pending, shows the count, and lists pending entries by type.
Section heading.
Preview sharing is optional and lets a non-editor read a draft.
A preview link needs a saved draft.
Share preview link mints a private address anyone can open without signing in.
The link is shown once with an expiry date and stops working after it.
Revoke all links disables each outstanding link for the entry.
Preview sharing is not available on every site.
Section heading.
History is opened from the overflow menu.
History lists past publishes newest first with who and when, and a pinned draft row without revert.
The list caps at the newest 25 publishes and states on screen when older ones exist.
After an address change, history goes back only to that change.
Revert loads the earlier text as a private unpublished draft without touching the live site.
Reverting is blocked while another editor has unpublished changes on the entry.
Reverting to a version with a removed field or tag warns and keeps only what the form shows.
Horizontal rule.
A freshness stamp naming a review date.
